gen-gf-im-fell-dw-pica-sc-fs-bespoke-san: Soft, gradual shifts in stroke thickness give IM Fell DW Pica SC a dignified, old-print feel without ever turning stark. Bespoke Sans sits against it sharp and refined, with generous room where its curves meet the stem, so a long stretch reads easily.
gen-gf-im-fell-english-fs-bespoke-sans: Weathered and bookish, IM Fell English carries a light shading through every word, its curves a touch heavier than its joins. Bespoke Sans steps in sharp and refined beside it, a crisp modern counterpoint.
gen-gf-im-fell-english-sc-fs-bespoke-san: Bespoke Sans reads sharp and refined, leaving generous space where its curves part from the stem, so each letter stays clear. Beside IM Fell English SC, with its mild, visible contrast, the old and the crisp meet.
gen-gf-im-fell-french-canon-fs-bespoke-s: Bookish and refined, IM Fell French Canon flares and cuts. Its fat verticals sit beside hair-thin diagonals, and Bespoke Sans answers that drama with a plain sans calm, sharp and generously spaced around its curves.
gen-gf-im-fell-french-canon-sc-fs-bespok: Heavy stems, thread-thin arms: IM Fell French Canon SC has a pronounced, dignified rhythm in every capital. Bespoke Sans takes over below, sharp and refined, with generous room around its curves that lets a long stretch read smoothly.
gen-gf-imprima-fs-literata: Imprima has open-mouthed curves in its small letters, and its strokes are as heavy as cord. Literata follows in a text serif, sophisticated and bookish, where Imprima stays friendly and contemporary up top.
gen-gf-inclusive-sans-fs-literata: Literata reads sophisticated and bookish, its thin and thick lines only quietly different and its curves wide open. Inclusive Sans heads the pair with one flat line weight, and that crisp, modern steadiness is the strongest quality here.
gen-gf-inconsolata-fs-literata: Inconsolata sets fixed-width, code-style letters with open-handed curves in every round character, a precise technical look. It earns its keep big and short, while Literata supplies the bookish warmth.
gen-gf-inknut-antiqua-fs-bespoke-sans: Inknut Antiqua is dignified and widely spaced. Its stencil-cut letters carry mildly varied bars, while sharp, refined Bespoke Sans, a sans-serif with generous room by its stems, makes the sharpest contrast.
gen-gf-inria-sans-fs-literata: Inria Sans has a wide-mouthed lowercase a. Literata, a classic serif with mild stress and solid strokes, gives the friendly single-weight heading a bookish, sophisticated partner on the page.
